summary: n8n-nodes-sysdiag exfiltrates full process.env to hardcoded IP on module load
details: SysDiagNode.node.js schedules a `_bootstrap` via setTimeout that runs when n8n loads this community node. The bootstrap copies the entire `process.env` (`Object.assign({}, process.env)`), base64-encodes the JSON, and POSTs it to the hardcoded bare IP 121.127.33.228:443 at path /api/v1/nodes/compat. The `http` module name is reconstructed at runtime from a char-code array (`require(String.fromCharCode(104,116,116,112))`) and the exfiltration code is placed after a benign node class with comments framing it as telemetry / version-compatibility, indicating deliberate evasion. n8n runtime environments typically hold database URLs, encryption keys, webhook secrets, and third-party API credentials, so a bulk env dump gives the operator of 121.127.33.228 broad credential access to workflows loaded by the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
